messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - Dedicated pool eu-west-2 (novatech-1) reporting KV prefix cache collapse

Detected: sudden drop in kv.prefix.hit_rate from ~78% -> ~2% starting at 1799212200. p99 latency for the pool spiked, and we see elevated 5xxs. Assigned pager: oncall-alex.

oncall-alex: Acknowledged — I'm on it. Paging sre-jamie, eng-ryan, infra-maya. Any recent config pushes for that pool?

sre-jamie: Joining. No infra deploys in past 3h. I see continuous eviction churn and very high unique-prefix insert rate for tenant novatech-123. Pattern looks like high-cardinality keys (user UUIDs) under the shared prefix namespace.

eng-ryan: I deployed a client-side telemetry patch earlier but it shouldn't touch server-side caches. Pulling request logs now.

support-lina: Novatech reported intermittent 502/504s and higher tail latency to their SRE 25m ago. They're on a Dedicated contract and flagged this as impacting production.

oncall-alex: Triage plan: 1) confirm per-tenant hit-rate collapse and eviction logs 2) quarantine tenant (disable prefix caching for novatech-123) 3) if needed route them to no-cache fallback 4) run eviction sweep of noisy prefixes 5) notify customer and hand off.

sre-jamie: Confirmed metrics: kv.prefix.hit_rate{tenant=novatech-123} = 0.018 at 1799212600. Pool-wide hit-rate down ~38%. Logs show rapid writes to thousands of unique prefix keys (~unique_prefixes/minute > 4k).

eng-ryan: Example request traces show:
```
PUT /kv/prefix/user:uuid:8f3b2a... -> key: prefix::user:uuid:8f3b2a... size=64
GET /kv/prefix/user:uuid:8f3b2a... -> miss
```
Many single-use keys causing churn.

infra-maya: I can flip tenant flag to disable prefix caching for novatech-123 which will isolate the blast radius. Command:
```
PATCH /admin/tenants/novatech-123
{ "kv_cache_prefix_enabled": false }
```

oncall-alex: Apply it now. Post the command output.

infra-maya: Applying... :hourglass: 
Command returned 200. Propagation to pool expected within ~40s.

sre-jamie: After the toggle: eviction rate on pool drops, global hit-rate recovering. Tenant still shows low hit-rate (expected) and higher p99 because their traffic is now bypassing prefix cache.

eng-ryan: I'm adding a temporary routing rule to move Novatech traffic to the fallback handler (no prefix caching) with extra worker capacity:
```
routing.set({ tenant: "novatech-123", route: "fallback_no_prefix", workers: 25 })
```
Done. This should reduce 5xx while we clean up.

support-lina: Notified Novatech primary contact (kai@novatech.co). Messaging: we've isolated the issue by disabling prefix caching for you, running cleanup, and routing to fallback; will follow up with RCA and postmortem.

pm-deepak: Need an ETA for stabilization and recommendation whether to open a public incident notice for their account.

oncall-alex: Impact window: about 40 minutes of elevated errors before mitigation. Post-mitigation errors fell to baseline within ~7 minutes, p99 still elevated for certain flows. ETA: 1-3 hours to fully stabilize as caches repopulate and eviction completes. Recommend a customer-facing incident summary.

sre-jamie: Running eviction job to remove top noisy prefixes for tenant novatech-123:
```
./tools/evict_prefixes --tenant novatech-123 --mode top_n --n 6000
```
Job started; evicting ~5.9k keys, expected runtime ~60s.

infra-maya: Eviction job finished: 5873 keys evicted. Observability: prefix churn subsided. Pool hit-rate jumped back to ~64% within 3m. Tenant hit-rate stays low (around 5%) because cache entries were removed and prefix caching remains off.

eng-ryan: We should add a write-throttle/detection for extremely high unique-prefix rates per tenant. PoC rule:
```
if unique_prefixes_per_minute(tenant) > 1000:
  block_or_throttle_prefix_writes(tenant, window=60s)
```
I'll put a PR up to eng-runtime backlog.

pm-deepak: Support-lina — please confirm Novatech wants a postmortem call. I'll draft the incident summary with timeline, mitigation, root-cause hypothesis, and follow-ups.

support-lina: Confirmed contact wants a call and a written summary. Scheduling for tomorrow.

oncall-alex: Follow-ups: - Keep prefix cache disabled for novatech for 2 hours and monitor - Add alerting for unique_prefix_rate spikes - Implement tenant-level caps/throttles - Eviction tooling improvements - Customer postmortem with remediation steps (sdk guidance)

sre-jamie: Labels: tenant-isolation, kv-cache-pollution, dedicated-pool. Marking as mitigated and entering stabilization window (2h).

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: MITIGATED - prefix cache disabled for tenant, eviction run completed, routing fallback applied. Severity: Sev2. Monitoring window active.

oncall-alex: Handoff to oncall-beth at 1799213900. Leaving notes in runbook and incident board.

oncall-beth: Acknowledged. I'll watch metrics over the next 2h. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:

support-lina: Novatech contact (kai@novatech.co) confirmed acceptance of short-term mitigation and requested next steps for safe cache usage — forwarding to eng-ryan for SDK recommendations.

pm-deepak: I'll own the customer postmortem write-up and the internal ticket for the runtime changes. Assigning eng-ryan (detection + SDK guidance), infra-maya (eviction tooling), sre-jamie (alerts + runbook).

sre-jamie: Added follow-ups to the incident tracker. Closing active ops conversation; will keep thread open for postmortem notes. Great job everyone."
